summary_1line: Amba performs extreme austerities for years, vowing revenge on Bhishma and seeking the power to destroy him despite warnings and curses.

image_candidates.scene_text: The princess Amba stands motionless in the Yamuna for a year, emaciated and matted-haired, performing fierce penance beneath the open sky.
Amba, thin and wrathful, stands on her toes eating only a single fallen leaf while ascetics watch her relentless austerity.
The river goddess Ganga rises from the waters and warns the stubborn princess that her vow will turn her into a harsh, crocodile-filled river.
